name: Bhindi Ka Salan
instructions: 1. Wash and dry the okra, cut them into 1-inch pieces, and shallow fry until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
2. In the same pan, heat mustard oil and temper with cumin and mustard seeds.
3. Add onions and sauté until translucent, then add ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
4. Stir in the turmeric, red chili, coriander powder, and roasted gram flour, cooking for a minute with a splash of water to prevent burning.
5. Whisk the yogurt and add it to the pan, stirring continuously until it bubbles.
6. Add tamarind pulp, salt, and enough water to reach desired gravy consistency.
7. Gently fold in the fried okra and simmer on low heat for 5-7 minutes.
8. Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and fresh coriander.
description: Bhindi Ka Salan is a staple in the Awadhi-influenced cuisine of Uttar Pradesh. It transforms the humble okra into a rich, flavorful dish that perfectly balances the earthiness of the vegetable with the tanginess of yogurt and tamarind, often served with Tandoori Roti or Naan.
